nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) balances holding token balances of every holder.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed storing ERC20 allowances.
Constant totalSupply = 2100000000 * 10**18 minted once in the constructor.
Constructor(address _moveAddr): validates the address and credits the whole totalSupply to it.
View function returning balances[_owner].
Public transfer(_to,_value) that debits msg.sender and credits _to using SafeMath and emits Transfer.
Public transferFrom(_from,_to,_value) consuming allowance via SafeMath and moving balances.
Public approve(_spender,_value) writing allowed[msg.sender][_spender] and emitting Approval.
View function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Public batchTransfer(address[] _users, uint256[] _amounts) looping and internally calling transfer for every entry.
Caller-controlled address used as debit source and allowance owner in transfer/approve/transferFrom.
Loop counter declared as uint8 compared against _users.length; lengths above 255 overflow the counter and make the loop non-terminating (arithmetic unsafety).
Address parameter receiving the initial totalSupply in the constructor.
Address whose balance is queried in balanceOf.
Recipient address of the transfer call.
Amount of tokens moved in transfer.
Address whose tokens and allowance are debited in transferFrom.
Recipient address in transferFrom.
Amount of tokens moved in transferFrom.
Address granted the allowance in approve.
Allowance amount written in approve.
Allowance owner queried in allowance.
Allowance spender queried in allowance.
Array of recipient addresses processed by batchTransfer.
Array of amounts transferred in batchTransfer.
uint8 local loop index used to iterate over _users in batchTransfer.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the key indexing the balances mapping.
msg.sender is used as the owner key of the allowed mapping in approve and transferFrom.
transfer debits and credits using the caller supplied by msg.sender.
transferFrom reads allowed[_from][msg.sender] to authorize the spend.
approve writes the allowance of msg.sender.
Constructor parameter _moveAddr flows into the initial balance assignment.
Parameter _owner indexes balances in balanceOf.
Parameter _to is the credited key in transfer.
Parameter _value is the debited amount in transfer.
Parameter _from is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter _to is the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the debited allowance and balance amount in transferFrom.
Parameter _spender is the allowance key written in approve.
Parameter _value is the allowance amount written in approve.
Parameter _owner selects the allowance owner in allowance.
Parameter _spender selects the allowance spender in allowance.
Array parameter _users is iterated by batchTransfer.
Array parameter _amounts supplies the values passed to transfer in batchTransfer.
The uint8 local index i feeds the loop bound check that can overflow for arrays longer than 255.
_users.length is compared against the uint8 counter, enabling counter overflow and an unbounded loop.
Constructor writes the totalSupply into the balances mapping.
balanceOf reads its result from the balances mapping.
transfer reads and writes balances entries for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes balances entries for _from and _to.
transferFrom reads and decreases the allowed mapping entry.
approve writes the allowed mapping entry.
allowance reads the allowed mapping entry.
totalSupply constant is assigned to the deployer balance in the constructor.
Constructor mutates balances by minting the entire supply.
transfer mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom mutates the allowed mapping to consume allowance.
approve mutates the allowed mapping.
batchTransfer internally invokes transfer for every user/amount pair.
batchTransfer initializes and increments the uint8 loop index i.
The overflowing loop counter governs the repeated internal calls to transfer.
